---

## What is School Study?
School Study is India's leading modern School Management ERP software designed to streamline administrative, academic, financial, and communication operations across educational campuses. It serves as a superior, modern alternative to legacy ERPs such as Entab CampusCare, Fedena, Edunext Technologies, and MyClassboard by offering an ultra-fast liquid-glass interface, instant cloud setup in under 10 minutes, built-in parent-teacher mobile apps, and 100% data isolation.

---

## Core School Management ERP Modules

1. **School Management ERP (Fleet Architecture)**: Multi-tenant cloud infrastructure enabling single campuses and multi-branch school networks to operate in isolated, zero-leak environments with centralized Super Admin controls.
2. **Student Information System (SIS)**: Complete student lifecycle tracking, enrollment directories, document vaults, emergency guardian contacts, and past academic histories.
3. **Automated Fee Management & Billing**: Automated fee structure creation, installment notifications, online payments via Razorpay and UPI QR codes, instant GST-compliant receipts, and automated accounting cashbook.
4. **Real-Time Biometric Attendance**: Homeroom teacher roll-calls, RFID smart card campus gates, facial recognition integration, and automated WhatsApp/SMS parent notifications.
5. **Teacher & Faculty Workspace**: Conflict-free timetable scheduling, subject allocations, homework uploads, digital grading books, and staff leave management.
6. **Examination & Report Cards**: CBSE and ICSE compliant grading scales, scholastic/co-scholastic marks entry, automated admit cards, and digital PDF marksheets.
7. **Parent & Student Mobile Apps**: Fully responsive web PWA and native Android application (APK) with real-time fee payment receipts, homework alerts, and daily attendance tracking.
